PLAN "12-week Vegan Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle gain"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 3x2m rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
